name: 2,3,4,5-tetramethoxyamphetamine
summary: Tetramethoxyamphetamine (TeMA), or 2,3,4,5-tetramethoxyamphetamine (2,3,4,5-TeMA), also known as 2-methoxy-TMA or 3-methoxy-TMA-2, is a drug of the phenethylamine and amphetamine families related to mescaline (3,4,5-trimethoxyphenethylamine).

fact.en: It is related to mescaline, the psychedelic from the peyote cactus, but carries a fourth methoxy group on the ring and the extra methyl of an amphetamine.
fact.zh: 它與仙人掌佩奧特（peyote）中的迷幻成分麥司卡林相關，但環上多了第四個甲氧基，並帶有安非他命的額外甲基。
fact.zhHans: 它与仙人掌佩奥特（peyote）中的迷幻成分麦司卡林相关，但环上多了第四个甲氧基，并带有安非他命的额外甲基。
